english.title: Use a vehicle so as likely to cause danger / nuisance to a person / persons on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on a part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..), used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in such a way as to cause or to be likely to cause danger or nuisance to a person or persons
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.2 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
